info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Rideshare Rides Cancel-v1-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Ride Cancellation API allows users to efficiently cancel scheduled rides within the rideshare platform. This endpoint is essential for managing ride alterations and ensuring flexibility for customers who may have changing plans. Typical consumers include riders needing to modify their ride arrangements and developers integrating ride management capabilities into their applications. By providing this functionality, the API enhances customer satisfaction and streamlines operations for rideshare services.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel an existing ride. On successful cancellation, the ride will no longer be active and users will receive a confirmation of the cancellation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send cancellation details for a ride. It allows the client to specify the necessary parameters required to cancel the ride successfully.

200.description: The ride cancellation request was processed successfully.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelRequest.description: The request body for cancelling a ride operation. This schema represents a simple string input for the operation.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelResponse_200.title: Cancel Ride Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the cancellation request.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation response.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelResponse_200.description: Response model for the successful cancellation of a ride operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation request was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit trail of the cancellation process.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
